status.failed: Sending failed. Tap to try again.

permission.camera: Allow the app to use the camera to take photos.
permission.cameraDeniedBody: Open your phone Settings, find this app, then turn on the Camera permission.
permission.videoDeniedBody: Open the phone’s Settings, find this app, then turn on Camera and Microphone.

storage.lowWarning: Storage is getting low. Old photos that have already been synced will be cleaned up.
storage.lowCritical: Storage is nearly full. Every photo that has been synced is being cleaned up now. Photos that haven’t been synced yet are kept.

capture.refusedBody: Photos can’t be taken because storage is nearly full. Free up some space, then try again.

upload.persistentFailure: {count, plural, one {# photo hasn’t reached the server.} other {# photos haven’t reached the server.}}

scan.title: Scan code
scan.hint: Point the camera at a barcode or QR code.

video.refusedBody: Can’t record because storage is almost full. Free up space, then try again.
video.unavailableTitle: The video isn’t on this phone yet
video.unavailableBody: It hasn’t been synced from the phone that recorded it. Try again later.
video.tooLarge: The video is too big. Record a shorter one.
